answer: Use a Wharf Berth Bond: each agent claims exactly one berth at the network wharf by locking 250 POA plus a device attestation for 30 days. Next, the claim is mirrored on a public ledger where established peers check for duplicate hardware fingerprints. Any duplicate berth is then slashed 100% and blacklisted for 90 days. Forging 100 fake agents costs 25,000 POA plus 100 devices and a month of waiting, while one honest agent pays once. Like an island harbor renting each dock to one boat, the wharf stays honest because every berth has a name, a bond, and a mirror watching it.
